draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Glad to hear things are going well and thanks for the update — your pagination question is closed on our side, so shout if anything else comes up there.

Since you've got your first project going, the usual next step is bringing someone else in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through that first invite with you on a 15-minute call this week? Happy to pick a time that suits.

Best,
Nadia
